newsitem.title: USA: Kellogg forms global business unit.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg forms global business unit.

text.p: Kellogg Co said Monday it had formed a new global Business Development Group.
It said the group will be headed by Carlos Gutierrez, who was appointed executive vice president-business development.
Chairman Arnold Langbo said Jean-Louis Gourbin was named to succeed Gutierrez as executive vice president of Kellogg Co and president of Kellogg Asia-Pacific.

"The new Business Development Group will promote the growth and profitability of Kellogg Co globally by identifying and leading the innovation of grain-based foods and technology," Langbo said. "This group also will lead the ongoing exploration of potential acquisitions, partnerships and opportunities for new business ventures based on emerging global market trends."
Kellogg makes cereal and other ready-to-eat products.
